groups.why_chosen: Sender and receiver of a real streaming system laid out as mirrored blocks, showing how forward data flow and two separate feedback loops fit in one compact diagram.
groups.what_to_learn: Mirror sender/receiver as matching grey boxes of blue sub-blocks; give bitrate control and fast re-sync each a bent-back feedback arrow, plus one arrow crossing the network to request re-sync — but identical labels leave only position telling sides apart.
